python3 - <<'PYEOF'
import sqlite3, re, os, glob
DATA=os.path.expanduser('~/.local/share/opencode')
DB=os.path.join(DATA,'opencode.db')
R='[REDACTED]'
rules=[
 (re.compile(re.escape('$'+'4,8'+'00'),re.I),R),
 (re.compile(re.escape('$'+'48'+'00'),re.I),R),
 (re.compile(r'(?<![\w])4,\??800(?![\w])'),R),
 (re.compile(r'(?<![\w":,}])48'+'00(?![\w":,}])'),R),
 (re.compile(re.escape('$'+'3'+'50'),re.I),R),
 (re.compile(r'(?<![\w":,}])3'+'50(?![\w":,}])'),R),
 (re.compile(r'\bdeb'+'ts?\b',re.I),R),
 (re.compile(r'\binc'+'ome\b',re.I),R),
 (re.compile(r'take[\s\-]*home',re.I),R),
]
def red(s):
    for rx,rp in rules: s=rx.sub(rp,s)
    return s
conn=sqlite3.connect(DB,timeout=60)
conn.isolation_level=None
conn.execute('PRAGMA busy_timeout=60000')
tabs=[r[0] for r in conn.execute("SELECT name FROM sqlite_master WHERE type='table'")]
changed={}
for t in tabs:
    cols=[r[1] for r in conn.execute('PRAGMA table_info("%s")'%t)]
    if not cols: continue
    rows=conn.execute('SELECT rowid, * FROM "%s"'%t).fetchall()
    upd=[]
    for row in rows:
        rid=row[0]; nv=[]; dirty=False
        for v in row[1:]:
            if isinstance(v,str):
                w=red(v); dirty=dirty or w!=v; nv.append(w)
            else: nv.append(v)
        if dirty: upd.append((rid,nv))
    if upd:
        conn.execute('BEGIN IMMEDIATE')
        for i,c in enumerate(cols):
            conn.executemany('UPDATE "%s" SET "%s"=? WHERE rowid=?'%(t,c),[(nv[i],rid) for rid,nv in upd])
        conn.execute('COMMIT')
        changed[t]=len(upd)
print('rows updated:',changed)
nf=[]
for p in glob.glob(os.path.join(DATA,'**','*'),recursive=True):
    if p.startswith(DB) or not os.path.isfile(p) or os.path.getsize(p)==0: continue
    try:
        s=open(p,'rb').read().decode('utf-8')
    except UnicodeDecodeError: continue
    w=red(s)
    if w!=s:
        open(p,'w',encoding='utf-8').write(w); nf.append(os.path.basename(p))
print('files updated:',nf)
conn.execute('PRAGMA wal_checkpoint(TRUNCATE)')
conn.execute('VACUUM')
conn.execute('PRAGMA wal_checkpoint(TRUNCATE)')
conn.close()
print('ok')
PYEOF
